Wenjun Li  
Email: wenjun.li@example.com | Phone: +91 9876543210 | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/wenjunli | GitHub: github.com/wenjunli  

Professional Experience  
As a data engineer at NexaTech Solutions, I have focused on building scalable data infrastructure to support startup growth. During my tenure as a Junior Data Engineer (2022–2023), I designed and deployed ETL pipelines that reduced data processing latency by 35% through optimized PostgreSQL queries and Apache Spark workflows. My work with Apache Kafka enabled real-time data streaming for customer analytics, handling 2.5 million events per day. I also contributed to the Snowflake data warehousing architecture, which supported a 40% improvement in query performance for business intelligence reports. Earlier, as a Data Engineering Intern (2022), I assisted in setting up cloud infrastructure on AWS, automating deployment processes using Docker, and integrating Snowflake with Databricks for data analytics. This role involved refining data pipelines that processed 15 GB of daily transactions, ensuring seamless data flow between staging and production environments.  

Education  
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, University of California, Irvine (2017–2021). Thesis: *Optimizing Query Performance in Distributed Databases Using Hybrid ETL Techniques*. This research explored the intersection of ETL pipeline design and database optimization, focusing on balancing batch and real-time processing for scalability.  

Technical Skills  
My technical expertise spans cloud infrastructure, data pipeline development, and analytics tool integration. I have implemented Apache Airflow to orchestrate complex ETL workflows, reducing manual intervention by 50% in production environments. My work with Apache Kafka involved designing fault-tolerant stream processing architectures, ensuring 99.9% uptime for critical data feeds. I have leveraged Apache Spark for large-scale data transformation tasks, including a project that processed 10 TB of user interaction data in under 4 hours. In data warehousing, I have architected Snowflake solutions that scaled to support 50+ concurrent queries, reducing ETL runtime by 25%. My proficiency with dbt enabled the creation of reusable data models, which improved reporting accuracy by 30% across multiple teams. I have also used Python for scripting data validation workflows and REST API design to expose analytics dashboards, integrating with internal tools for real-time monitoring.  

Projects  
At NexaTech Solutions, I led the development of a Snowflake-based data warehouse that consolidated data from 12 disparate sources, resulting in a 60% reduction in data latency for cross-functional teams. This project involved designing dbt models to automate data transformations, which cut manual ETL effort by 40%. Another key project involved optimizing Kafka streams for event-driven architectures, achieving 95% message throughput with minimal latency. I also contributed to a Dockerized deployment of Airflow, which streamlined CI/CD processes and improved pipeline reliability.  

Publications  
*“Hybrid ETL Pipelines for Scalable Data Warehousing: A Case Study,”* Journal of Data Engineering (2023). Co-authored with team members, this paper discusses the implementation of hybrid batch-stream processing techniques to enhance data pipeline efficiency.  

Awards & Achievements  
Recognized as NexaTech Solutions’ Rising Star in Data Engineering (2023) for contributions to Snowflake integration and dbt model optimization. Received a university-level research grant (2021) for exploring distributed query optimization techniques in PostgreSQL.
